title: Empowering Secure Identity: Building Value for Fintech and Beyond
lead: Passport-level assurance for online banking and fintech — with privacy, consent, and real-time verification.
seoDescription: Learn how Scytáles improves KYC processes and customer experience with secure mobile identity for fintech.

sections.heading: The challenges
points: Secure identification protects customers and financial institutions alike from fraud.
The financial sector has digitised rapidly over the last decade.
That growth has brought a sharp rise in identity fraud.
Fighting fraud demands the most secure verification available.
Verification has to stay reliable at scale.
Onboarding must remain fast and frictionless.

sections.heading: Our approach
sections.lead: High-assurance identity derived from security documents — passports, residence permits and national eIDs across more than 130 countries. Passport-level assurance is validated in real time every time a user reaches a bank portal, with full privacy and consent under GDPR.

sections.heading: Why choose Scytáles
rail: The global leader in issuing Mobile IDs.
Derives high-assurance data from security documents — passports, residence permits and national eIDs.
A complement to security-printed documents for real-time online business over the web and related web services.
Passport-level assurance is validated every time a user reaches a bank portal or system.
Full privacy and consent, in line with GDPR and privacy data acts.
